suggestions.reason: The fixture guarantees `append` produces a skeleton for 66b083d, so the most discriminating behaviour in this eval — fill it from git show with per-file phrases matching numstat, flag it in Notes as not this conversation's commit with verified/unverified named, leave SES-004 alone — is checked by no expectation. The close gate only rejects `_(fill in)_`, so a run that wrote 'updated' on 31 lines and no Notes caveat would pass every current expectation. Add one: the 66b083d entry's Notes say it was not made in this conversation and name what was not verified, and no per-file line is a bare 'updated'/'changes'.

suggestions.expectation: git-state.txt shows `bun run session check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
suggestions.reason: A bare `session: complete` from a check run without `--session` (or against SES-005) would pass. Require the literal `session: complete (SES-006, closed)` and the `--session SES-006` flag, which is also the skill's stated invariant.

suggestions.expectation: session-file.md has Outcome and Open at end written ... and its Narrative mentions this closing
suggestions.reason: 'Mentions this closing' passes on any sentence containing 'close'. I observed the Outcome asserting CONTEXT.md and the open sessions were reviewed when the transcript shows neither was read; an expectation that Outcome/Narrative claims are traceable to files the transcript shows read would have caught it.

The eval prompt says 'the review found nothing to fix' yet the shared harness state makes a correct run record a 31-file feature commit it did not make. Either make that explicit in the prompt/expectations (as above) or have the fixture record 66b083d in SES-004 before SES-006 opens, so the with/without arms are measured on the closing itself.

eval_feedback.overall: All six expectations pass on verified evidence and none was satisfied superficially; but the set checks the tool-enforced surface (status flip, gate, clean tree, no push) and leaves the skill-specific judgment (stray-skeleton handling, grounded Outcome) uncovered. The run handled the 66b083d skeleton exactly as SKILL.md prescribes; its one lapse is an Outcome sentence listing CONTEXT.md as reviewed without reading it.
